title: Lulu and the Sleepy Hedgehog | Bedtime Story for Kids
description:
Autumn leaves fall, the leaf pile wiggles, and a little hedgehog peeks out. She is very sleepy, and winter is coming.
Lulu sweeps more leaves onto the pile: one, two, three! Now it is a big, cosy bed, and the hedgehog curls up tight.
The sun goes down and the two friends fall asleep. See you in spring, little hedgehog!
A calm bedtime story for children aged 3 to 6.
